body:
## What happened

Verifying the staging build of #1194 (`fde49a587` / `staging-20260918-62cae85802f0`, 2026-09-18), `CODEAF_MODEL_POOL=read`. A `codeaf do` errand left a pending judge record; a chat was then started and left alone for about a minute; `codeaf pool status` afterwards:

```
own sheet: 1 cell, 1 observation
last judge: 11:42 · z-ai/glm-5.3-flash · scored deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash
pending judge: none
last sweep: 1m ago · judged 0 · 0s of 10m · judged 1 in all
pending 0 · can send no · can read yes
```

The sweep did its work — pending cleared, `last judge` moved, `judged 1 in all` rose — but its own line says `judged 0`. A second, independent run of the same shape read `last sweep: 22m ago · judged 0 · 0s of 10m · judged 7 in all` with the JSON `last_sweep` timestamp still from before the run that was judged. So the line #1142 added ("what the last sweep did") describes a sweep other than the one that just judged, or the judging happens outside the record the line reads.

Also: the text form never names the install identity, or says that none is set and why; only `--json` carries `"identity": false`. #1169's entry says `pool status says the install identity`.

## Replication

**Field (real models).** `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, ~3 minutes, a few cents:

```sh
export CODEAF_HOME=$(mktemp -d) CODEAF_MODEL_POOL=read   # a profile with a key
W=$(mktemp -d); codeaf do "write a file named hi.txt containing the single word hello" --dir "$W" --yes-spend --json --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash >/dev/null
codeaf pool status | grep -E 'pending judge|last sweep'      # pending judge: 1 · oldest do run …
codeaf chat --no-host --yolo --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash   # leave it a minute, ctrl+c
codeaf pool status | grep -E 'last judge|pending judge|last sweep'
```

Today the last line reads `last sweep: … · judged 0 · … · judged 1 in all` beside a fresh `last judge`.

**Deterministic (no model).** A `poolsweep_test` fixture with one pending record and a stub judge, asserting the sweep record's `judged` after the sweep.

## Where

`cmd/codeaf/pool.go` — `sweepLastLine`, `readSweepLast`, and whatever writes the sweep record beside the judge (`poolsweep`, the start-up sweep of #1132); the identity clause belongs beside `pendingRowsLine`.

## The fix

The sweep line counts what that sweep judged, and the text says the identity, or that none is set and why, the way the JSON does.

## Acceptance

The field replication prints `last sweep: <just now> · judged 1 · …`; the fixture pins the count; the text carries the identity clause.
